verdicts.reason: A fills almost the whole canvas with the dark panel, so the green background and the original product-over-panel structure are gone. Its logo is jammed against the top edge and collides with the panel's top border, and a big dead gap separates the can from the CTA. B keeps the green field and the original structure, but the can's base touches the panel top and the logo sits in an arbitrary top-right spot instead of centred. Its panel bleeds off both sides, leaving the CTA pill with almost no side margin.

A keeps the can on green above the panel with a clean gap and a well-proportioned headline and CTA. However, the logo has moved to the bottom of the panel, so the brand now comes last in the reading order and looks like a footer, and the panel bleeds off the sides. B has the can's base touching the panel, an off-axis top-right logo, and an oversized headline and CTA crammed edge to edge with minimal margins.
